name: Kyle Dillehay
short_bio: Kyle Dillehay is a sculptor, installation artist and photographer working in stone, cast iron and wet-plate collodion.

sources.label: Tacoma Arts Month: Tacoma Studio Tour 2026 artist map

biography: Kyle Dillehay makes sculpture and installations and photographs with wet-plate collodion, a 19th-century process. His work returns to the built environment and its effect on land, from Anasazi stone architecture in the American Southwest to the trulli of Puglia in southern Italy.

Born near Chicago and raised in northern Alabama, he began travelling and photographing in the 1980s, including projects in Panama and Nicaragua, and has since shown sculpture, installation and photography.
